authorization: Carlos：流星划的距离稍长、频次稍多；保留细尾与安静错开节奏。
function: vec3 meteor_light(vec2 uv, vec2 viewport_size, float meteor_t)
clock: Shared weather clock, offset once on reaching midnight. Starts at 2.0, 6.8 and 11.6 seconds; no independent timer. Returning fully to morning resets the next night group.
compositing: Add through the existing sky_mask and the shared night transition weight. These weights are applied by the caller, not inside this include.
rhythm: Three staggered meteors per 32-second group; no overlap. Travel and lifetime both increase 50%, preserving head speed; tails increase 30%. Shared freeze holds heads and tails.
placement: Reference pixels are measured at 1920×1080, upper-left origin. The head moves diagonally from upper right toward lower left in the current central sky opening. Trees occlude it through the existing sky mask.
